description: This file defines the SystemDataController class, an ASP.NET Core API controller that provides an endpoint to retrieve various system data entities from a database, serialized as JSON.

classes.name: SystemDataController
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core API controller that handles GET requests to fetch various system data entities from the database.

methods.name: GetData
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve specified entities from the database, serialize them to JSON, and return as a downloadable file.

methods.name: BuildLoaders
methods.description: Constructs a dictionary mapping entity names to functions that load the corresponding data asynchronously from the database.
